description: This file defines the 'HttpsEnsuringDirective' class, which is a custom Akka HTTP directive used to enforce HTTPS connections for incoming requests. It includes logic to check request headers, potentially redirect to HTTPS, or reject non-HTTPS requests based on configuration.

classes.name: HttpsEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A final class providing a custom Akka HTTP directive to ensure requests are made over HTTPS, with optional redirect or rejection based on configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of HttpsEnsuringDirective with provided HTTP configuration.

methods.name: ensureHttps
methods.description: Wraps an inner route with logic to enforce HTTPS, redirecting or rejecting non-HTTPS requests based on configuration and headers.
